svg.text: Building Input and Target Sequences in custom_collate_fn
Toy batch from the notebook: pad, shift by one, then mask the padding in the targets
C. Inputs and targets: the targets are the inputs shifted one position left
Position i of the input is trained to predict position i of the target,
i.e. the token that comes next. Example: input 5 -> target 6, input 6 -> target <|endoftext|>.
first 50256 = <|endoftext|> (kept: teaches the model to stop)
In custom_collate_fn, every 50256 in the targets except the first is replaced by -100, so padding never contributes to the loss.
